newsitem.title: UK: MEPC gains on renewed talk of Hammerson bid.
newsitem.headline: MEPC gains on renewed talk of Hammerson bid.

text.p: Shares in MEPC Plc edged higher on Thursday after a press report revived speculation of a bid from rival Hammerson Plc, dealers said.
MEPC shares were up 3p at 482 in volume of 859,905 shares while Hammerson was unchanged at 431-1/2.
A report in the Times noted that several lines of MEPC stock had been traded late on Wednesday and said there was talk of a possible Hammerson bid.
The two terminated previous merger talks earlier this month.

A spokesman for MEPC declined comment on the latest bout of market speculation but said the company believed strength in its shares reflected a refinancing announcement earlier this week, when it cancelled some interest rate swaps to cut financing costs.
At Hammerson a spokesman said the company had nothing to add to its previous statements.
